text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty: latency-p99 spike detected in us-west (service: inference-hotpath). p99 ~ 1.2s, p95 ~ 420ms. auto-pager fired. Incident ID: PD-48372 :rotating_light:
maya: seeing the PD page, looks like a small burst. anyone oncall?
sam: I'm oncall, grabbing it. which model/route?
incident-bot: Affected route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-v2-medium). Traffic sample shows increased queueing on sidecar and elevated host CPU.
sam: sshing into router logs now. pinging metrics dashboards.
raj: fyi earlier we rolled a tiny change to autoscaler policy in us-west-2 last hour — could correlate.
ellie: can we confirm customer impact? any 5xx or only tail-latency?
sam: quick look — error rate steady, 2xx mostly, but long TTFB for a subset. looks like KV cache miss storm + batching blowup.
maya: can you post the grafana query and top hosts?
sam: Grafana query: 
```
sum(rate(request_duration_ms_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (le,instance)
```
Top instances: infer-usw-14, infer-usw-22 showing heavy queue_depth, CPU 95%.
raj: autoscaler didn't spin up additional pods, suspicious. checking controller logs.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-48372 acknowledged by sam at 1781234580.
sam: acked, will triage. first step: temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 4 for redwood-v2-medium on those hosts to lower latency tail. issuing patch now.
maya: +1 for small batch, that should reduce queueing. any plan B if batching change not enough?
ellie: plan B: route a small percent (5-10%) of traffic to redwood-v2-small fallback model to preserve latency for customer-facing flows.
raj: controller logs show failed scale attempt due to quota error — autoscaler hit pod creation quota for that namespace. I'm clearing a couple of stale pods now.
sam: batch size change rolled to infer-usw-14 and infer-usw-22 via k8s patch: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/redwood-v2-medium MAX_BATCH_SIZE=4 --record
```
Applying to the two problem nodes.
maya: monitoring the p99 after patch.
(2m later)
sam: p99 on those instances dropped from ~1200ms to ~430ms within 90s. system p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 520ms overall.
ellie: routing plan active?
sam: routing 7% traffic to v2-small using weight tweak: 
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.local/routes/adjust -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"redwood-v2-medium":0.93,"redwood-v2-small":0.07}}'
```
Traffic shift applied.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-48372 note: escalation suppressed by oncall at 1781234589 due to active mitigation.
maya: good catch on quota, raj. please follow up on why autoscaler couldn't create pods — filing ticket after incident.
raj: filing INF-1229 for quota/root cause + follow-up with infra.
ellie: customer impact assessment: based on traces, ~2.1% of total requests experienced >1s TTFB during peak 1781234560-1781234580 window; no increase in error rate. recommend SLO breach notification to affected customers but not an incident SEV escalation.
maya: agree. add a note to the postmortem about autoscaler quota interaction and consider pre-warming.
sam: oncall handoff incoming in ~20 minutes to @oncall-rotation. I'll keep watch and add a short runbook entry: 
- If p99 > 800ms after mitigation: revert weight to v2-small 15% and open PD again.
- If autoscaler continues to fail: manual pod replace and contact infra.
oncall-rotation: I'll take rotation in 20m, leave my pager unmuted. any open actions to hand off?
sam: open items: (1) infra ticket INF-1229, (2) monitor kv cache evictions (we saw spike in evict rate), (3) validate autoscaler permissions. I pushed short notes to #incidents-daily.
maya: did we need to debounce future autopages? this was a short burst but PD fired.
ellie: yes we should consider a debounce window: autopage only after sustained p99 > 800ms for 90s, otherwise alert to channel but don't page. will sync with alerting team.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: PD-48372 auto-pager suppressed, mitigations in place. Please add final status when stable.
sam: marking thread for postmortem writeup. adding timeline and metrics snapshot.
oncall-rotation: acknowledged handoff at 1781234599, I'll follow up in morning. leaving single-threaded follow-up tasks in ops board. :white_check_mark:
